      Sspark expands sports portfolio with Chhattisgarh Hockey League mandate

      Sanctioned by Hockey India, the inaugural season will feature six franchises: Rajdhani Royals, Chitrakoot Challengers, Sanskardhani Strikers, Chakradhar Champions, Nyayadhani Knights and Mainpat Titans.

      By Aashay Khandelwal
      October 8, 2026
      WhatsApp
      Linkedin
      Facebook
      X
      Telegram
        Listen to audio version of this article
        Sponsored by
        0:00 / 2:16
        Instaread

        Sspark Sports & Entertainment has been appointed by the Department of Sports & Youth Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh, to manage the inaugural Chhattisgarh Hockey League (CHL), adding another state-backed sporting property to the company’s growing portfolio of league and event management ventures.

        The franchise-based league will be held from October 21 to November 1 at the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Hockey Stadium in Raipur. Sanctioned by Hockey India, the inaugural season will feature six franchises: Rajdhani Royals, Chitrakoot Challengers, Sanskardhani Strikers, Chakradhar Champions, Nyayadhani Knights and Mainpat Titans.

        Sspark will manage the league across its operational and commercial functions, including franchise management, sponsorship and commercial development, marketing, public relations, digital and social media, player and team management, venue operations, match-day delivery, production and fan engagement.

        Commenting on the appointment, Rajeev Khanna, Founder & Chairman, Sspark Sports & Entertainment, said, “The Chhattisgarh Hockey League is an exciting opportunity to build a meaningful sporting property from the ground up, with it being India’s first-ever state-run hockey league. Chhattisgarh has a strong hockey culture and a deep pool of talent, and the league will enable us to provide that talent with the right platform, competitive environment, exposure and professional ecosystem required to progress further. We are delighted to partner with the Department of Sports and Youth Welfare on this ambitious initiative and look forward to bringing our experience across league management, sports operations, commercial development and fan engagement to build a property that can grow sustainably over the years. What makes this an exciting opportunity for Sspark is the prospect of replicating world-class delivery to hockey fans around Chhattisgarh and all of India.”

        The league is expected to bring together emerging players from Chhattisgarh and established Indian hockey talent, creating a competitive environment that can provide local athletes with greater exposure and experience.

        For Sspark, the appointment builds on its experience across sports league management, venue operations, sponsorship, event production and fan engagement, including its involvement with the Uttarakhand Premier League.

        The CHL also forms part of Chhattisgarh’s broader effort to strengthen its sporting ecosystem. With professional league management, commercial development and fan engagement integrated into the property, the inaugural season could establish a platform capable of expanding the state’s hockey ecosystem in the years ahead.
